requirement: In every row with pre.i_reset=1, post o_scyc and o_sstb are 0 (DUT). Master CYC/STB high in a reset row following a reset row is an environment violation. At a reset row all hypotheses, live entries, orphans and canceled identities are discarded and reset_epoch increments; cumulative unresolved records (tags flushed from surviving histories) persist. o_mack/o_merr in reset rows are judged only by K13 and rule 3.45.
assumptions: One sampled reset row counts as one complete cycle (rule 3.05 not otherwise observable)

requirement: Acceptance is CYC&STB&!STALL per port per row; each such row is one request. Identity is (WE,addr,SEL) for reads and additionally SEL-enabled data lanes for writes. Undefined identity projection on an accepted or held strobed request is an env violation on a master port and a DUT violation on a slave port.
A slave acceptance on port s requires decode(addr)==s; unmapped addresses are never forwarded.

Each slave acceptance consumes exactly one identity-equal candidate (live unforwarded entry of any master from rows <= c, or a canceled-pool member), each at most once, branching over all candidates; a hypothesis with no candidate dies. Association-free projection: per identity, slave acceptances <= master acceptances in the reset epoch.
support_status: implemented; per-candidate part suspended on exhaustion, count projection always exact

requirement: Forward and side-effect order is NOT judged, within or across slaves.

A master response in row c retires that master's oldest live entry from rows < c; an ACK or non-HR ERR with no such entry kills the hypothesis. An ERR under HR(m,c) (held, or acceptance edge after identical held row) branches: A ordinary retirement; B retire nothing (possible_starvation_err); in case (ii) B2 moves the row-c entry to the canceled pool tagged starvation_attributed. Association-free bound: ACKs + non-HR ERRs in the current CYC <= acceptances in earlier rows of that CYC; HR ERRs counted separately. Repeated HR ERRs during one held request are not judged and stay unknown. Boundary row e: an ACK-driven count-bound failure depends only on pins and rows < e and stays dut_violation; an ERR-driven one depends on row-e HR inputs and becomes mixed_same_edge. hr_err_unjudged counts HR ERRs excluded from the bound.
support_status: implemented; inferred; suspended on exhaustion except count bound

requirement: A master ACK requires the retired entry to be bound to a slave ACK in a row <= c in the same hypothesis; for reads the full 32-bit o_mdata equals that slave ACK's i_sdata slice.

ACK retiring an unmapped or slave-ERRed entry kills the hypothesis; ERR retiring them is consistent; ERR retiring a mapped entry without slave ERR is tagged unexplained_mapped_err (unknown). No eventual-ERR or deadline claim.
source: WB B4 perm 3.20, rule 3.45; crossbar article; wbxbar.v header 32-39
support_status: implemented; unknown cases unresolved; suspended on exhaustion

requirement: On a row with pre i_mcyc[m]=0, unforwarded live entries become distinct canceled-pool members tagged (master, master_epoch, reset_epoch, accept_row); forwarded ones become orphans whose slave responses bind positionally and never reach a master. Consuming a pool member (including same-row as the drop) is tagged post_abort_forward. Canceled identities persist until reset.
assumptions: No C1 certificate, so no mid-epoch release

requirement: A DUT-stalled slave request must persist with identical identity projection or o_scyc drops; o_sstb without o_scyc and o_mack&o_merr are violations; undefined DUT control outputs are violations.

Master hold change/withdrawal under stall with CYC high, slave ACK&ERR together, slave response with empty FIFO or while o_scyc is low, undefined i_sdata on a slave ACK whose public per-slave forward FIFO head (pin-derived, association-free) was a read, undefined inputs, malformed rows and missing initial reset are environment violations (input_or_scope_invalid). Slave CYC withdrawal marks FIFO forwards slave_canceled. Processing stops at the first env row e.

Live non-slave-canceled entries unretired at trace end in any surviving history yield pending_at_batch_end (unresolved), never a liveness failure; slave_canceled live entries, pool members and orphans are non-obligations (counted only).
o_mack/o_merr with pre i_mcyc low in rows c-1 and c is a DUT violation; if i_mcyc fell exactly in row c it is unresolved same_edge_response_after_abort and never retired.
assumptions: First trace row has no c-1 and is not judged

requirement: Default MAX_HYP=4096, MAX_LIVE_PER_MASTER=64, MAX_CANCELED_POOL=256; optional limits dict (development selftests only) validated as positive ints. On exhaustion: no pruning, unresolved_on_limit with sizes, association clauses suspended for all masters until reset, suspended rows/fraction reported.

DUT violations wholly before e stay dut_violation; pin-only DUT checks at row e stay, including the ACK-driven K6 count bound; ERR-driven K6 count failures, K4 count projection and membership death at row e become mixed_same_edge unresolved; at any first invalid-input boundary (env violation, schema failure, or mixed death) the tags of histories feasible at the start of row e are flushed once as open valid-prefix unknowns with original tag rows, never as refuted and never including tags created in row e; K11 env checks are counted per non-reset row in subobligation K11_env_checks (input schema validation and reset-row rule 3.20 checks are not instrumented as activations); otherwise input_or_scope_invalid if e exists, else violation > unresolved > scoped_pass. Prefix status reported. scoped_pass excludes K5 and C1-C4 and means not refuted by the reference.

counts.subobligation_activations gives per sub-obligation activations, checked_activations, suspended_activations and post_death_activations; counts.clause_scope sums them per clause with raw_activations and unknown_tag_records. Association-free sub-obligations are checked in every mode. Exhaustion records state snapshot (pre_expansion_branching_precheck or post_expansion_step_check) and actual vs projected hypotheses. Membership-death records disclose omitted dying-row tags. Activations are exposure, never cover or proof.
source: Review R4/R5 (reporting decision, not normative protocol authority)

requirement: Formal obligations F1-F8 and characterization C1-C4.
